note: Every entry is a complete projection that the producer guard AND every consumer parser must refuse, designed so that exactly ONE rule rejects it and every neighbouring invariant stays satisfied. The baseline must be accepted by both. Error wording is deliberately not part of this contract; the proof of isolation is that deleting a single guard makes that guard’s cases parse.

refusals.name: unexpected-top-level-key
refusals.why: An unexpected key is corruption, not an extension.

refusals.name: unsupported-contract-version
refusals.why: A later contract version must never be read as this one.

refusals.name: missing-channel
refusals.why: All four channels are always published.

refusals.name: invented-fifth-channel
refusals.why: A fifth channel needs a new contract version.

refusals.name: public-channel-withheld
refusals.why: Public channels are always answerable.

refusals.name: withheld-form-with-wrong-status
refusals.why: The one-key form is the withheld form and nothing else.

refusals.name: channel-extra-key
refusals.why: A channel carries exactly its four contract fields.

refusals.name: channel-status-not-canonical
refusals.why: A status outside the canonical set is not a status.

refusals.name: answered-channel-claims-unavailable
refusals.why: A channel that answered cannot also claim it could not look.

refusals.name: run-count-not-a-number
refusals.why: A run count is a bounded non-negative integer.

refusals.name: run-count-fractional
refusals.why: A run count is a bounded non-negative integer.

refusals.name: run-count-negative
refusals.why: A run count is a bounded non-negative integer.

refusals.name: timestamp-invalid-calendar-day
refusals.why: Matches the shape and throws RangeError when rendered.

refusals.name: timestamp-normalized-noncanonical
refusals.why: February 30th does not throw: it silently becomes March 2nd.

refusals.name: timestamp-non-leap-february-29
refusals.why: Not a leap year: silently becomes March 1st.

refusals.name: timestamp-full-precision
refusals.why: The contract promises a bounded UTC day, not an exact time.

refusals.name: evidence-type-missing
refusals.why: All four evidence types are always published.

refusals.name: evidence-type-invented
refusals.why: A fifth evidence type needs a new contract version.

refusals.name: evidence-type-extra-key
refusals.why: An evidence entry is exactly a status and a count.

refusals.name: evidence-type-status-not-canonical
refusals.why: A status outside the canonical set is not a status.

refusals.name: evidence-type-withheld
refusals.why: Only a whole personal fit may be withheld; a withheld TYPE reads as a measured zero.

refusals.name: evidence-count-not-a-number
refusals.why: An evidence count is a bounded non-negative integer.

refusals.name: evidence-count-fractional
refusals.why: An evidence count is a bounded non-negative integer.

refusals.name: evidence-count-negative
refusals.why: An evidence count is a bounded non-negative integer.

refusals.name: evidence-type-counted-while-empty
refusals.why: A type cannot report no evidence and carry evidence.

refusals.name: evidence-type-hollow
refusals.why: A type cannot claim evidence and count none.

refusals.name: count-exceeds-run-count
refusals.why: A favorable count is a count of runs, so it cannot exceed them.

refusals.name: channel-claims-evidence-it-lacks
refusals.why: A channel cannot claim evidence none of its types carry.

refusals.name: channel-hides-evidence-it-has
refusals.why: A channel cannot report none while holding some.

refusals.name: certification-authority-invented
refusals.why: v1 has no certification authority anywhere.

refusals.name: certification-measured-empty
refusals.why: Even measured-and-empty asserts an authority v1 does not have.

refusals.name: neutral-benchmark-measured
refusals.why: v1 has no benchmark authority, so a benchmark result cannot exist.

refusals.name: neutral-benchmark-counted
refusals.why: An unmeasured channel cannot have run against anything.

refusals.name: neutral-benchmark-timestamped
refusals.why: An unmeasured channel has no latest evidence to date.

refusals.name: unknown-channel-holds-measured-evidence
refusals.why: Unknown is a statement about a whole channel.

refusals.name: measured-channel-holds-unmeasured-evidence
refusals.why: A measured channel cannot contain an unmeasured type other than certification.
